title: Syrian Yeasty Gooey Pork Hot Pot
description: A hearty, comforting Syrian dish featuring pork and a crispy, yeasty exterior.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, yeast, and warm water to form a dough.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and let rise for 1 hour.
Heat the oil in a hot pot over medium heat.
Sear the pork shoulder until browned on all sides.
Add the onion and garlic to the hot pot and saut46 until the onion is translucent.
Add the tomato paste to the hot pot and stir to combine.
Add the risen dough to the hot pot, covering the pork and vegetables.
Cook for an additional 20 minutes, or until the dough is golden brown and crispy.
Serve the hot pot hot, garnished with fresh parsley if desired.
